Scientific Hypothesis: In the context of South American freshwater fishes, the evolutionary traits "RML_evol" (Rate of Relative Maxillary Length evolution) and "OGP_evol" (Rates of Oral Gape Position Evolution) exhibit negative relationships with speciation rates ("BAMM_speciation"). This suggests that higher rates of these traits are associated with lower speciation rates. The coefficients for these relationships are approximately -5.65 for "RML_evol" and -7.80 for "OGP_evol", indicating statistically significant negative associations.
